Recto

  1. Friday, 17 Siwan 1493, in Dār al-Zayt: Clay, 2. Gypsum, 2 1⁄2 1⁄3.

  2. A jar and a buckle, 1⁄2 1/3. Food, 1 1/2. A ladder, ¼ ⅓. Removal of garbage, 9 3/4. 

  3. Mawhūb and an apprentice, 7. Helpers, 5. The overseer,1 1/2. Total, 30 ¼ ⅓. 

  4. Collection for clothes for the year 

  5. 1497

  6. Paid to al-Shayk al-Mēvīn…
